title: widget icons in /examples/ are cryptic
body:
I know they are beautiful but on the /examples/ page they are raising the [FUD](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fear,_uncertainty_and_doubt).

What do you think?

I would remove them, even adding a tooltip etc won't do it I think (mobile being another reason). Too much level and quantity of information at once I feel.

(I had to say it :D)

![2015-11-17 14 51 59](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/11213621/314f08fc-8d3d-11e5-92a8-7f5456ab8b9e.png)

comments.body: Yep, not sure if this is needed. I don't mind keeping them because they are pretty :p but it's hard to get what they mean without tooltips.
It's up for 1.0.0. Let's wait for negative feedback on this point to decide if we move forward, ok? How about closing this one for now?
I am ok closing this one, not a big deal
